message.content:
The Declaration of Independence was signed by 56 delegates representing the thirteen American colonies. Some of the most well‑known signers include:

| Signer | Colony |
|--------|--------|
| John Hancock | Massachusetts |
| Benjamin Franklin | Pennsylvania |
| Thomas Jefferson | Virginia |
| George Washington | Virginia |
| John Adams | Massachusetts |
| Samuel Adams | Massachusetts |
| Patrick Henry | Virginia |
| John Jay | New York |
| Alexander Hamilton | New York |
| James Madison | Virginia |

These individuals were among the 56 men who affixed their signatures to the document on August 2, 1776, officially declaring the colonies independent from Great Britain.
